title: Travel with Ivan
text:
Ivan took us to an olive oil processing facility and introduced us our guide. We were incredibly fortunate to have timed our trip to coincide with the olive harvest and pressing. Local olive growers were showing up with small trailers filled with olives and leaving with 25L jugs of unfiltered olive oil. Fascinating to watch.
Next stop was the Roman ruins in Tarragona where you can see the original Roman walls underlying walls from the  Middle Ages and serving as foundations for modern buildings as well. Ivan knows his stuff and we learned a lot.
author: billw518

title: Ivan was a great tour guide
text:
It was a great tour. It was my first private tour and I wish all of them could be like that. Ivan was knowledgeable and it was feat to have a discussion about the Roman ruins. He answered every question we had. We had extra time before the olive oil tasting. Instead of just waiting around, Ivan took us to Rey’s and we saw an amazing house (with all of its original 1800s features) and the birthplace of Gaudi. 

Walking among the olive trees was amazing for this city girl. We were able to watch part of the process. It was very interesting. Best part was buying the olive oil and olives for home.
author: Marisa C

title: Awesome Time
text: Our tour guide Ivan spoke English very well and was informative as well as entertaining throughout the tour of Tarragona. He is very knowledgeable about Spanish, Catalonian & Barcelona history.
author: Madeline C

title: Lovely experience!
text: I loved the tour, especially the visit to the stunning Roman amphitheater and the views of the Mediterranean Sea. Ivan has been very friendly and has shared his deep knowledge of the history of the city, which has made the experience even more enriching. Thank you very much for the opportunity to discover the treasures of Tarragona!
author: yanirac560

title: A trip you will NEVER FORGET
text: This isn't the first time I've been to Tarragona, but this time, being accompanied by our favorite tour guide Ivan, was truly different! He shared his immense knowledge about Tarragona's rich history, particularly highlighting a lot of fascinating details only locals would know or pay attention to. A big thanks—we had such a great time
author: WingNLi

title: Tarragona. Modernist Gem And Olive Oil Tasting - Private Tour
text: My trip to Spain was greatly enhanced by our wonderful tour guide Ivan. His knowledge of the early history of Tarragosa and Resu was a highlight of my trip, beginning with the stop for a view of the aqueduct, then the ancient ruins scattered throughout the city as well as the unexpected wedding at the Cathedral. This was followed by a visit to an olive plantation that was both fun and educational. Definitely a new experience for me. I would highly recommend this trip with Ivan.
author: rpurdom75

title: Excellent Day Trip Option Outside the Frenzy of Barcelona
text: Since I had a party of four, I arranged a private tour with Ivan.   I was in Barcelona celebrating my Aunt’s 75th Birthday, and I wanted a unique experience that balanced the frenzy of Barcelona.    Ivan did a fantastic job.  He had a very comfortable vehicle, spoke great English and provided historical context all through the tour.  This tour takes you on a drive through the Cava and wine region, which is a beautiful, while taking in some unique stops along the way. title: Friendly and informative
text:
Ivan is very friendly, responsible, and speaks multiple local languages. These qualities help him guide tourists with ease.
He took us to Tarragona and Reus.  When it rained, he provided some umbrellas and smoothly adjusted  plans so we could enjoy many sites.
author: chrispO3072LO

title: Authentic Spain
text: Ivan gave us a glimpse of the past and present. From Roman ruins to current-day olive oil producers, we enjoyed our day with a top-notch guide.
author: Virginia C
